name: Single-Source Widest Paths
problem_statement: For each vertex v, maximize the minimum edge capacity along a directed path from a designated source to v.

normalization: Retain directed arcs; undirected edges become symmetric arcs.
Parallel arcs can be collapsed using maximum capacity.
Self-loops do not improve widest paths.

required_outputs.name: bottleneck_capacity
required_outputs.description: Best capacity, null for unreachable vertices; the source uses null with reachable=true and is_source=true to represent +infinity.

required_outputs.name: reachable
required_outputs.description: Reachability, distinguishing source infinity from unreachable null.

required_outputs.name: is_source
required_outputs.description: Exactly the designated source is true.

required_outputs.name: predecessor
required_outputs.description: A witness path tree; null at the source and unreachable vertices.

solution_semantics.objective: For each vertex v, maximize the minimum edge capacity along a directed path from a designated source to v.
solution_semantics.exactness: Exact mathematical objective; implementations must declare approximation and termination status.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Each external vertex ID occurs once; output multiplicities follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No ordering among equally valid solutions is required.

validation_rules: For reachable non-source vertices, a predecessor path realizes the reported bottleneck.
Compare bottleneck values with a max-min semiring reference, not sum-of-weights shortest paths.
Unreachable vertices remain unreachable even when all reachable capacities are zero.
edge_cases: The source has an empty path with infinite bottleneck.
Disconnected graphs and isolated sources are legal.

correctness: For reachable non-source vertices, a predecessor path realizes the reported bottleneck.
Compare bottleneck values with a max-min semiring reference, not sum-of-weights shortest paths.
Unreachable vertices remain unreachable even when all reachable capacities are zero.
